verdicts.reason: A has a clean top-to-bottom story: headline, subcopy, product, then CTA. Its flaws: the SOLSTICE logo sits off-centre to the right of the badge instead of on the central axis, the headline sits on the large translucent circle, and there is a big dead gap between the can and the CTA. B keeps the original order, but the small decorative circle lands right behind 'Light' and looks like a collision. B also leaves about 150px of empty space between the headline and its subcopy, has an off-centre logo and a badge pushed down into the big circle, and its headline and can are small for the canvas.
